# WCAG 2.2 Coverage Matrix

<!-- GENERATED by `npm run docs:wcag` from src/utils/wcag-criteria.js and the rule registries. Do not edit by hand. -->

Automated checks cover 27 of 55 WCAG 2.2 A and AA criteria (1 fully, 26 partially); 28 need manual review. Partial coverage does not replace manual review.

Coverage levels: **full** (automated checks decide the criterion's testable requirement), **partial** (some failures are found, a person must still check), **manual-only** (needs human judgement), **none** (automatable in principle, no rule runs yet). Partial is never counted as full.
Axe rules come from axe-core 4.12.1 (tags run by the scanner), accessScan rules from the registry, html-validate rules from the default preset (rules set to off are not listed). Keyboard, focus-trap, aria-live and screen-reader probes are not in a registry and are not counted. Rules without a WCAG criterion (best practice) are not listed.
